title: That Pizza Place
address: 210 Heaton Moor Rd, Heaton Moor, Stockport SK4 4DU, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Zei Gol
user_reviews.Description:
We ordered pizza for a party last night, and it was amazing! The pizzas were fresh, hot, and incredibly tasty. Everyone at the party loved them, and several guests asked where they were from.
The variety of pizzas was excellent, the delivery was punctual, and everything arrived in perfect condition.  Great food, great service, and a great experience overall.
Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious pizza!

user_reviews.Name: D.Baker
user_reviews.Description:
A small takeaway place in Heaton Moor. Not much place inside at all to sit in and enjoy a pizza. So if you visit make sure you have somewhere to go and eat your food. There is a little bit of space outside but the weather needs to help if you are planning to sit outside and eat.

A very good variety of pizzas. For a takeaway place the pizza is really good. The reason for the 4 stars rather than 5 is that 5 is reserved for high quality restaurant pizzas made with hand stretched thin dough and super fresh ingredients.

Prices are nice and competitive to other pizza takeaway places. The quality overall is much better than generic kebab and pizza places, no doubt.

So, if you are going to order a pizza go to this place and not a generic pizza kebab place with lower quality ingredients and a ton of unhealthy cheese.

Staff are friendly and smiley and accommodating.

I have been a customer for a long time now and will continue to visit.

title: Off The Hook Fish And Chips
address: 8 Northenden Rd, Sale M33 3BR, United Kingdom

owner.name: Off The Hook Fish And Chips (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Billy Goodwin
user_reviews.Description:
Part of me didnt want to write this because I realise it was your first day open, but I felt compelled to leave a review. The old chippy was pretty good and high quality, even if it was a bit expensive and we would visit regularly.

I appreciate you were very busy, but surely you should have known and prepared since you started off with 50% off the menu. The FOH staff are brilliant, but working in hospitality myself it was evident that the new management are having a hard time with their timings on the food.

The batter for the fish was appalling. It was pale, greasy, mushy and most of it was stuck to the paper it was wrapped in so it ended up coming off anyway.

The chips were also pale and a little bit sad, and the curry sauce was as thick as mayonnaise. Honestly glad we didnt get as much as we would normally as we havent ended up eating it!

Hope it gets better or we would have lost a brilliant chippy.

The location is good; it’s on Northenden Road in the town centre of Sale, with the Metrolink station close by.

The interior is quite nice and does include a couple of tables to dine in. It’s also spacious and didn’t feel crowded when multiple people were waiting to order or for food to be ready.

I ordered gluten-free fish and chips. I did feel the gluten-free selection overall was pretty poor; there were no sides and no sauces; it was pretty much just the fish and chips. Usually, chippies which offer gluten-free will at least have a curry sauce or gravy, as the previous owners did, but sadly that wasn’t the case here.

I was also disappointed with the quality of my food overall; the chips were overcooked, the fish was soggy and had a nasty aftertaste, and I couldn’t finish my food. Due to the poor execution of the gluten-free fish and chips and the poor selection overall, it kind of gave me the impression that they’re only offering gluten-free because the previous owners did, and they haven’t got things right just yet, but hopefully this can change in the future.

I’m not sure if I would return right now, but this place does have potential for sure due to the nice interior and location.

Firstly the positive. I arrived early Wednesday evening. No one else in the take away and was greeted really warmly. Smiles and eye contact  given when they were busy with getting takeaway boxes ready for orders. A warm welcome is not always guaranteed, so full marks there.

They took my order- I asked for two large fish & chips, nothing too challenging. The price was a bit shocking & expensive- it was £22 for that….😳okay, so I was expecting great things. I Didn’t have to wait too long to receive them, and cycled home. On opening the boxes… was a bit shocked, there were plenty of chips, but we were not given large fish… I’d be pushed to call it medium fish… it was more like a small fish with large chips. (See photo) very disappointing and angry that they signed and boxed that off as large fish especially after paying so much for something so paltry.

On eating it, the chips did not have a great taste, could have been a dodgy batch of potatoes? The fish and the batter it was in was only okay, not described as haddock or cod… just ‘fish’ and honestly was on a par with fish fingers freezer food.  So after this experience unlikely to buy our F&C again from there. 😞quality control not great in this instant.

user_reviews.Name: Innerspace
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve known Jake for many years. Initially, the energy he creates feels incredible to be around, but after observing his behaviour over a long period, I’ve found myself questioning what’s really going on beneath the surface.

When people enter healing spaces, they should be able to trust that the energy and intentions behind them are genuine. In my opinion, I’ve seen a shift from helping people towards self-interest, and greed. While everyone has a past and deserves the opportunity to grow, I would expect someone facilitating healing to demonstrate integrity, humility and to put the wellbeing of others first.

My observation is that someone leading others through healing should have done significant work on themselves before guiding others. I’ve also noticed that Jake’s work appears to remain within the Lighthouse Hub rather than extending into the wider community, which has only reinforced my own concerns.

My advice to others is simply to look beyond first impressions, trust your instincts, and be mindful that what you see on the surface isn’t always the full picture.

I've just attended a weeks conference at the Lighthouse Venue, and particularly in these unusual times the venue was exceptional. The venue itself is a great space. It is clean and comfortable.

The team ensured they maintained the measures they had put in place to create a CoVid compliant venue. Clear signage of one way routes and PPE guidance was displayed. The toilets were cleaned regularly and a system had been put in place to keep numbers to a safe amount. In the conference room itself we were asked to keep the same space for the week. The tables were sufficiently spread out. For a conference of approximately 50 delegates at no time did we feel anxious about social distancing.

The catering was excellent as were the staff. They were friendly and efficient. There was plenty of on site parking available.

I would highly recommend this venue.

There is a good selection for vegetarians too. I decided to have the falafel sandwich and a Cappuccino. The coffee wasn’t the best and could have done with being a bit more thick and airy to create the frothy milk foam. The falafel sandwich was lovely but my only criticism would be have a more generous layer of the hummus. The staff were friendly and chatty and greeted me with a warm welcome. There is an outside sitting area however it’s looks over at the busy road and a block of flats which would put me off stopping for refreshments on a hot sunny day!

user_reviews.Name: Thyme Traveller
user_reviews.Description:
​If you’re looking for a solid spot with a nice menu and tasty food, this is it. The variety is impressive, but they don't sacrifice quality for quantity.
Cold Mezze was a fantastic start,everything tasted incredibly fresh.
Lahmacun was genuinely addictive. It’s seasoned perfectly and has that ideal crunch. I honestly couldn't stop eating it.
The Aubergine Dish was absolutely mouthwatering.
Mixed Grill  was the biggest surprise for me. The meat was exceptionally well-seasoned and cooked just right.
I’ve been searching for a place in the city center that actually has Cheese Kunefe in stock and serves it right, and I finally found it here!
Definitely worth a visit if you want a reliable, delicious meal without a pretentious vibe.

user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Insha Mokaram
user_reviews.Description:
We ordered qabli pulao, fatyar, and a chicken tikka wrap. They served us soup first that was very tasty . The qabli pulao was honestly the best I’ve ever had — full of flavor and perfectly cooked. That was definitely the highlight of our meal.

The fatyar was just okay, nothing special but still decent.

Unfortunately, the experience with the chicken tikka wrap was very disappointing. We were initially told that the chicken was finished, so we agreed to cancel the wrap. However, it was later brought to us anyway. The wrap itself was very poor — it was basically a large naan stuffed with what tasted like undercooked, smelly chicken tikka and random naan pieces. When I took a bite, it was so unpleasant I almost felt sick.

When we raised the issue, the staff old man insisted that there was nothing wrong and kept saying “this is good,” instead of acknowledging our concern. We ended up leaving the wrap.

Overall, while the qabli pulao was excellent, the poor quality of the wrap and the staff’s unwillingness to accept feedback was very disappointing. Even small takeaways serve better wraps than this.

user_reviews.Name: Nathan Ramsden
user_reviews.Description:
One word. Perfect.
Let's start with the aesthetic. A very relaxed and trendy environment great for any sized parties.
The service was impecable. I called the night before as I have a milk and egg allergy and wanted a recommendation of what to order.
They said they could make me any of the meats fresh on the grill without milk. I was expecting to be ordering a vegan dish.
I came in today and was given the option for a whole mixed grill. They changed parts out that I couldn't eat and the meal was excellent.
The chicken was moist. Everything had a lovely char. The lamb chop really stood out. The fries were crispy and light.
The salad was vibrant
Aydyn was incredibly accomodating and made sure everything was to our liking. He even came out to make sure I did not eat the bread we ordered for the table. I had already looked at the allergy menu and was aware but the thought and knowledge of each ingredient was impressive.
This has to be the best experience I have ever had at a restaurant with having a milk and egg allergy. They swapped parts of the meal and cooked me a meal that I really wanted.

Thank you to all of the staff, but especially Aydyn for the wonderful service.

user_reviews.Name: R4HMANS
user_reviews.Description:
​If you are looking for an authentic taste of Turkish hospitality in the heart of Manchester, Ottoman Grill & Bar is an absolute must-visit. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between upscale elegance and welcoming warmth.
​Why It Earns 5 Stars:
​The Food: The charcoal-grilled meats are the star of the show. The Adana Kofte and Grilled Prawns were perfectly seasoned, juicy, and infused with that distinct smoky flavor you can only get from a traditional grill.

​The Service: The staff is incredibly attentive without being overbearing. They are knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations—especially when it comes to the mezze platters.

​The Ambiance: The decor is stunning, featuring beautiful lighting and a sophisticated layout that makes it ideal for both a romantic date night or a lively celebration with friends.

​The portion sizes are generous, the ingredients are clearly fresh, and the presentation is top-tier. It is easily one of the best spots for Mediterranean cuisine in the city. I’ll definitely be back soon!

title: Istanbul Restaurant Manchester
address: 2 Bury Old Rd, Manchester M8 9JN, United Kingdom
description: Relaxed choice for classic Turkish plates including pide & lamb kebabs, plus vegetarian options.

user_reviews.Name: Being Nav
user_reviews.Description:
If you want a fabulous, personable and enjoyable dining experience then you must visit Istanbul in Manchester.

Arrived late on Sat evening and there is a designated car park (plenty of free street parking)

Immediately upon entering warmly greeted by the front entrance staff and every member of staff is a credit to this place. Super friendly and helpful.

Decor is lovely and space is large and the toilets were very clean with another seating area upstairs. Music being played (traditional Turkish) adds authenticity and isn't overly loud.

Food was first class. From the lentil soup to one of the best hummus I have ever had. Truly delightful. Fresh and warm bread immediately given with lovely sauces and olives. Each item ordered including our drinks came promptly. I have hands down never been to any restaurant where the service was that quick. Impressive!

For the quality of food, service, ambience and the price Istanbul is a MUST VISIT and a place I will happily recommend and can't wait to return.

title: The Chip Shop
address: Gateway House, Unit 2 Piccadilly, Manchester M1 2GH, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Mands
user_reviews.Description:
One thing that I LOVED about this place was that they fry the chips on the spot. I had the time to wait, so when I got the food it was warm and freshly fried.
The list keeps going on, but I’d like to highlight:
- the external area, as the indoors may smell like deep fry (although, they keep the door open which helps with the smell)
- the generous amount of chips even on the Mini version
- the chicken mushroom pie was 😋 chef’s kiss.
- the packaging for take away my left overs
- the lady who packed also gave me a little cup with some curry sauce to try, and let me tell you what. As someone who grew up in Japan, this curry took me back there. If I had a bowl of rice I would’ve been the happiest person right there.
- the staff was also really kind
I’m 100% going back to the Chip Shop next time I stop at Manchester, and it’s just outside Piccadily station so it’s very handy. Worth every pound spent 🫶🏻

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Dunstan
user_reviews.Description:
After going to the Museum of Science and Industry on a visit to Manchester we really fancied some "proper chips".
A nice lady at the museum told us that there's a chippy nearby.
Wow what a find!
This chip shop is very much like one you'd find on a sea front.
Plenty of seating inside on two levels and very clean with charming black and white pics from days gone by adorning the walls.
It felt like a nice family atmosphere.
I did ask for my peas and curry sauce to be put on top of my chips- you can get them in separate pots by the way.

The staff were very friendly and professional.

My ten year old said that these were the best chips he'd had in his life, I think they're a close level-pegging with something you'd get at somewhere like Scarborough.

We'll definitely go here again next time we're in Manchester.

RECOMMENDED :)

I’ve up loaded some photos.

On a brighter note the jalapeño bites were really nice!!

user_reviews.Name: Farouk Bhatti
user_reviews.Description:
Well, well, well. What a pleasant surprise.

Atlantic Fish Bar is the sort of place you can walk into with low expectations and walk out wondering why you haven’t been coming here all along. I had a takeaway tonight and was greeted by a genuinely lovely duo behind the counter — friendly in that increasingly rare way that doesn’t feel as though it has been prescribed by a customer-service manual.

I went for the No. 2. The sauce was supplied with almost uncanny precision: neither the timid drizzle of someone frightened of condiments nor the drowning usually reserved for a shipwreck. Just the right amount, as though they knew me.

The fish was fresh, properly cooked and, importantly, still tasted like fish. The chips initially looked a little underdone, but appearances were deceptive. They were actually spot on — soft where they should be, crisp where they mattered, and seasoned properly. There is something deeply satisfying about a chip that has been given enough salt to remind you that you are eating chips, rather than a potato-based health food.

I swapped the peas for curry sauce because I’m up North now and apparently this is what happens to you. I haven’t tried their peas yet, but I suspect I’ll be back to correct that omission.

The tartare sauce isn’t homemade, which is hardly unusual these days, but frankly, at this price and with this level of care, I’m not going to start demanding that someone pickle their own gherkins out the back.

Good fish. Excellent chips. Proper portions. Friendly service. Sensible prices.

Sometimes the best meals are the ones that don’t announce themselves as anything special. Atlantic Fish Bar is one of those places. I’ll be back.

side I got curry sauce

salad
10/10
Fresh and crunchy salad

drinks

Very expensive now since prices have gone up and could be so much better if they made fresh chicken products like they do with fish.

user_reviews.Name: L' Hill
user_reviews.Description:
My daughter and I bought in-store.

As soon as we walked in, the heavenly smell hit us, and we both proclaimed how good it smelt.

The room was clean, tidy, and nicely decorated and we even made reference to the art details that were painted on the wall 👌

I ordered a small cod, it was really cute, and actually ample for me (middle aged woman) as a main, and I reckon it'd be ample for my 14 year old son (who eats loads) too. My daughter chose the sausage which she tells me was "yeah, it was good" (high praise from a teenager 😆).

I shared a large chips with my 16 year old, to accompany our mains. Again, it filled the two of us, but it did look a *lot* smaller than I had expected it would be, as there were three sizes to choose from so I would imagine this to be a medium at an average chippy. I had hoped for that price, to have left overs to share with the other kids when we got home, but as it stands, please just don't tell them that we went, and I reckon we can just about get away without them knowing that we'd had it without them 😆

The pots of gravy and mushy peas were tiny. No where near enough to accompany the half a large chips per pot that we had planned on. And at £2.00 a pot I expected much more. I suspect much of the costing went on the very nice thick paper cups, the wooden cutlery wrapped with napkins, and of course a side of healthy profit.

The food was amazing! It was hot, crisp, salted to just the right amount, and beautifully flavourful. In fact, all food pics were taken after sampling a couple of mouthfuls because there was no way I was waiting to start so I could take a photo first 😆

Finally let's talk about prices. It's much more than I'd usually be willing to spend in a local chippy, but... It was extra quality along side the extra cost, so I guess it's a case of "getting what you pay for".

So would I come back? If I had the money and it was a treat, then, yes I would! And I'd be keen to try the battered halloumi. But it's not something I could frequent as a regular occurrence due to its prices, in this cost of living crisis.

Constructive suggestion; a couple of seats in there for the chance to sit while your food is being freshly cooked, would've been ideal and a real blessing to me.

Beyond that, great job guys n gals,
4.5⭐ out of 5.

user_reviews.Name: Dom
user_reviews.Description:
Lived in the area for a few months but never tried until last night, we’ve walked past it numerous times and it always seems clean and as though they’re cooking everything fresh. Decided to give it a try last night and was blown away.

Went in to collect and saw them actually cutting potatoes to make chips fresh. Curry’s were amazing, so flavourful. Bhuna was a tad oily but didn’t ruin any of the flavour. Chips and naan were best I’ve ever had.

Masala was proper red and sweet type, which is my dream but understand this might not be to everyone’s taste.

This is best curry I’ve had in Salford by far, everywhere else seems bland in comparison. If you can I’d go collect, was so much quicker and service was brill. Will definitely be back soon.

user_reviews.Name: Sibu Thomas
user_reviews.Description:
Tried Kappa Biriyani recently, and it was absolutely worth it for the quality and taste considering the price they charge.
The highlight for me was their Nadan Porotta and Beef Coconut Fry truly delicious and packed with authentic flavor. Also tried their Thattukada Chicken; if you enjoy spicy food, this is a must-try. It has that perfect higher-note spice ++ kick.
Last but not least, the Nadan chai was splendid and completed the experience perfectly.
Their service as well excellent within their limitations.

user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely Authentic Kerala Flavors – A Must-Visit!

I recently visited this wayanad taste and it instantly transported me to the backwaters of God's Own Country!

We started with crispy Kerala Porotta paired with rich Beef Fry – the flavors were perfectly balanced with fresh coconut, curry leaves, and bold spices. Fish pollichathu was outstanding – tangy, coconutty, and packed with authentic taste.
The portions are generous, prices are very reasonable, and the service is friendly and attentive. They even played soft Malayalam music in the background, making the whole meal feel like home.

user_reviews.Name: Will Scott
user_reviews.Description:
I picked this restaurant for a catch up with a friend who works nearby, and boy am I glad that I did.

It's quite a small restaurant, with exceptionally friendly staff.  As we'd not seen each other for 9 months that took about 30 mins, and the staff left us alone, not rushing us at all.

The menu is quite different. I've never before seen chicken drumsticks stuffed with minced lamb and nuts (Third Eye Tangri), nor naan stuffed with potato and cheese (Pommi Nan), or onion-stuffed flatbread (Onion Kulcha).

The other starter we had was Chicken Momocha, and the mains were Makhan Chara (the Chef's specialty) and Lamb Shah Jani
. I highly recommend both. I don't think I've ever had curry dishes with such tender meat.

The only odd thing was the poppadums. I suspect these were shop bought, and rather small, but given they were amazing I guess that doesn't matter too much. We just ordered more.

As well as the food being amazing, the price was too. Just over £60 for poppadums, two starters, two main courses, rice, two breads, and two pints of lager.

I will definitely come back here.

The food was phenomenal and the price is pretty reasonable for the quality of the meals and the vibe of the restaurant.  The service was also great, very helpful and friendly but not intrusive.

I came with my Dad for my birthday and we shared the mixed meze plate (the fresh baked levash bread with the spiced butter and the içli köfte were particularly exceptional). We then shared a mixed grill (the lamb chops and the chicken wings were my favourite) and a findik lahmacun for mains. We just managed to squeeze in a delicious serve of the katmer for dessert. The only thing that would have really made it better would be some kind of refreshing house-made fresh lemon drink or similar, but the ginger beer was still pretty great!

Definitely one of my new favourite places in Manchester.

user_reviews.Name: Katie Maddock
user_reviews.Description:
I have been coming here since I was little with my father and now as I'm older, with my partner. The service from all the staff is always spot on and so kind and welcoming. It's the only Chinese or chip shop I will go to in the whole of Rossendale. Always loved this place but today I find myself having to write a review for all to see as I've been ill recently and not well enough to leave the house to collect and it's the same day unfortunately that their delivery driver has been taken unwell. Thinking that they would just tell me they can't deliver I was ready to end the call politely and try to think of something I could eat cold from the fridge.
However I was so wrong! They were more than happy to go out of their way to make sure I could have the food delivered, the gentleman came to my door in his own car! user_reviews.Name: Shanoof Basheer
user_reviews.Description:
Fortune House has proven to be a true culinary gem with its exceptional Chinese cuisine. Our dining experience at this establishment left us in awe of the delightful flavors and impeccable service. From the moment we stepped in, we were greeted warmly by the staff and seated promptly, setting the tone for a memorable evening.

Appetizers:

We started our culinary journey with a selection of appetizers that included Prawn Crackers and Salt and Pepper Chicken. The Prawn Crackers were crisp, light, and had a wonderful prawn flavor, making them an excellent start to our meal. The Salt and Pepper Chicken was a delight for our taste buds - crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with the perfect balance of seasoning that left us craving for more.

Main Course:

Moving on to the main course, we ordered the Crispy Chilly Beef and King Prawn Chowmein. The Crispy Chilly Beef was a showstopper! The beef was fried to perfection and coated in a delectable blend of spices, offering an explosion of flavors with each bite. The dish had just the right amount of spiciness, which added to its charm. As for the King Prawn Chowmein, it was a masterful combination of succulent prawns, perfectly cooked noodles, and an array of fresh vegetables. The flavors melded together seamlessly, making this dish a standout.

Crispy Duck:

One of the highlights of our meal was undoubtedly the Crispy Duck. The duck was flawlessly cooked, with a crispy and golden skin that encased tender, succulent meat. Served with pancakes and a variety of condiments, assembling each mouth-watering bite was a joy. The richness of the duck was beautifully complemented by the accompanying sauces, resulting in an explosion of flavors that left us mesmerized.

Overall Experience:

Fortune House not only impressed us with its delectable cuisine but also with its attentive and friendly staff. The ambiance was cozy and inviting, creating a perfect setting for a relaxing meal. The dishes were served promptly, and the presentation was visually appealing, indicative of the care and attention to detail put into each creation.

In conclusion, our dining experience at Fortune House was exceptional. The Salt and Pepper Chicken, Crispy Duck, Prawn Crackers, Crispy Chilly Beef, and King Prawn Chowmein were all outstanding dishes that surpassed our expectations. We wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking an authentic and flavorful Chinese culinary experience. Fortune House truly lives up to its name, delivering a fortune of delightful flavors!

user_reviews.Name: danielle raen
user_reviews.Description:
my partner and i came in to celebrate our 7th anniversary, as this is the first place we had a date night when we first visited manchester while thinking about moving here. as always, the food was amazing. we split the garlic bread appetizer and it is AMAZING. indulgent, cheesy, garlicky, salty, bready. could house several of these. there’s nothing else you really need, and yet we carried on. my husband got the triple pepperoni and a crispy diet coke. classic, perfect, satisfying. i stole pepperonis off his pizza while he wasn’t looking and was very surprised to find it was incredible. like it tasted like it belongs on a fancy charcuterie board. ANYWAY, i ordered an entire burrata to myself because it’s my favorite thing in the world and we were celebrating and life is short, so eat the entire burrata. i could write a novel about my feelings on burrata and how much i love this particular one, but i wont. just get it. i also got a cesar salad and rudy’s is not shy with the parmesan, which is truly beautiful. i did end up covering it cracked black pepper. i did whack some cesar dressing drenched romaine leaves on my crispy bread and then topped it with burrata, some of the best little tomatoes i’ve ever had (rudy’s always has good tomatoes, i can trust them) and some dressed arugala. savoury girls get it. OH also i got a cloudy apple and cherry spritz and this is literally my favorite drink ever and ive tried to recreate it at home but i cant, so rudy’s has a lifetime customer.

anyway, all of this was made possible by our incredibly personable server, emily. she was warm and very accommodating, she got all of our food perfectly, and did so while buzzing around a very busy restaurant, but i never saw her break a sweat. she also took a beat to have a chat with us, and when she found out it was our anniversary, she got us some tiramisu (to takeaway, we were very full) she was super sweet, witty, and gave very cool, chill vibes. anyone who is lucky enough to get her as a server is in for a treat.

IN CONCLUSION thank you for the cozy night out helping us celebrate. we loved the food, the staff, and the overall inclusive vibes. we will 100% be back again, this is a favorite date night spot for us. thank you emily!!!! 🩷🩷🩷

also p.s. the tiramisu was an utter joy to consume

user_reviews.Name: Akshata Shenoy
user_reviews.Description:
Myself and my family are really fond of the food at Dosa Kings. Honestly the best South Indian food especially their regional Tamil and Kerala dishes are our favourite. Last time we ordered so many varieties so clubbing all of them together.
We tried their Thayir Vadai which is Medu vada dunked in curd and topped with some mixture. The paper dosa, Mysore masala dosa and ghee roast dosa sent me to food coma. Their Sunday buffet had so many options. Lamb biryani was outstanding. Loved how fluffy the poori was. Do try Veechu paratha (you won’t find it anywhere else) with chicken tikka masala. If i could pick 2 dishes to have everyday it would be their szhecuan prawns and Paan shots, such a refreshing drink. Do try their homemade cocktails as well. The lamb chukka and kothu paratha is best for the meat lovers. The owners and staff are so friendly. And did you know they have done the interiors themselves? Do visit and show some love.

user_reviews.Name: pradeep vijigiri
user_reviews.Description:
I visited this restaurant as soon as it opened at 5:00 pm and was the very first customer. I requested a table for two and was shown a very small table with chairs that didn’t look particularly comfortable. As I’m a bigger person, I politely asked if I could instead use one of the available four-person tables for a more comfortable dining experience.

I was told that those tables couldn’t be offered because the restaurant was expected to get busy. I completely understand the need to manage seating during busy periods. However, I stayed until around 6:30 pm, and throughout my visit several larger tables remained empty. None appeared to be reserved, and none of the customers who arrived after me had reservations either. It was disappointing that some flexibility couldn’t be shown, especially as I was the first customer of the evening. A little empathy in this situation would have gone a long way.

The service also left room for improvement. My starter, Chicken 65, arrived first, but I then waited around 20 minutes for the rest of my order. I was informed the kitchen was busy due to another event, but when I placed my order the restaurant was empty, and it never became particularly busy during my visit.

After finishing my meal, I also had to remind the staff that I was still waiting for my filter coffee. Even after the reminder, it took another 15 minutes to arrive.

As for the food, there were some excellent highlights. The Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani was genuinely authentic—one of the few places that truly captures the traditional flavour. The dosa was a perfect 10/10, the parota was outstanding, and the filter coffee reminded me of the authentic filter coffee you get in Tamil Nadu.

The only dish that disappointed me was the Chicken 65. It seemed to be simply deep-fried chicken topped with onions and served with mint chutney. Traditionally, Chicken 65 is finished with a tempering of curry leaves, green chillies and spices, which gives it its distinctive flavour. Without that, it didn’t feel like a true Chicken 65. I also felt it contained an excessive amount of red food colouring.

Overall, the kitchen clearly has talented chefs, and several dishes were exceptional. However, a dining experience is about more than just the quality of the food. Comfortable seating, thoughtful customer service, and timely delivery of the meal all contribute to the experience. Having my meal arrive in stages with long gaps between courses made it difficult to enjoy, and I hope the restaurant considers improving these aspects. With better hospitality and more attentive service, this could easily become one of my favourite places to eat.

user_reviews.Name: Shaista Mohammad
user_reviews.Description:
We had such a lovely lunch at Dosa Kings! We started with the Lemon Margarita, which was so refreshing. For starters, we ordered the Gobi Manchurian and Chilli Fish—both were absolutely delicious and full of flavour.

For mains, we had the Mysore Masala Dosa and the Idli Vada Combo, and both were an easy 11/10. The dosa was perfectly crisp, and the idli, vada, and sambar tasted authentic and comforting.

We ended our meal with a filter coffee, which instantly made me miss home. ❤️

The ambience made it feel like you’d walked into a warm South Indian home, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better.

If you’re in Manchester and craving authentic South Indian food, this place is definitely worth a visit. We’ll definitely be back!

title: Rudy's Pizza Napoletana - Portland Street
address: 30 Portland St, Manchester M1 4GS, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Jose Mendoza (Ralf X)
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited Rudy's Pizza Napoletana on Portland Street, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish.

The first thing that stood out was the warm welcome from the staff. Everyone was friendly, professional and genuinely attentive, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere from the moment we arrived.

The restaurant has a lively yet comfortable feel, with a great balance between authentic Italian character and modern style. Despite being busy, the service remained efficient and personable throughout our visit.

Of course, the highlight was the pizza. Freshly prepared, perfectly cooked and full of flavour, it was easy to see why Rudy's has built such a strong reputation. The dough was light and beautifully textured, the ingredients tasted fresh and high quality, and every bite felt like a true Neapolitan pizza experience.

The food arrived promptly, the service was excellent, and the overall value for money was very good considering the quality of the ingredients and dining experience.

If you're looking for delicious pizza in Manchester, Rudy's Pizza Napoletana on Portland Street is well worth a visit. Great food, friendly staff and a welcoming atmosphere make this a place I would happily recommend and return to in the future.

user_reviews.Name: Jools Turton-Spence
user_reviews.Description: WOW!! All of the staff are so tentative and lovely, Daina was our waitress for the evening and she was extremely helpful with such a lovely disposition, THANKYOUU DAINA! The food here is always 10/10 and we can recommend it enough. The portion sizes are huge. Thankyou MyLahore!!!!

user_reviews.Description:
We visited MyLahore for lunch today for the very first time, and our experience was made absolutely exceptional thanks to our server, Nadeem. From the moment we were seated, he was warm, welcoming, and attentive in the most genuine way.

We both ordered the Chicken Dum Biryani, and when Nadeem brought the dishes over, he took the time to carefully cut into the dums for us. His presentation made the experience feel even more special.

Nadeem’s professionalism, kindness, and pride in the food truly elevated our first visit. Thanks to him, we’re already looking forward to coming back!

I visited with friends for drinks and had a great time.  The lady serving was beautiful and well versed in wine and champagne.  She recommended a wine journey for my partner and champagne for myself and every recommendation was perfect.

If you want some recommendations for wine and champagne go pay them a visit.

user_reviews.Name: Drywall Machines Ltd
user_reviews.Description:
Discovered this hidden gem in Timperley today — Cofi Club! I had my first visit and was pleasantly surprised by the quality and attention to detail. ☕✨

I ordered a Full English breakfast, a matcha latte, a slice of lemon cake, and a refreshing glass of cold water with ice (a lifesaver in this summer heat!). Everything was absolutely delicious, and the presentation was on point. 🍳🍰❄️

The atmosphere inside was very welcoming. You could tell the place had been freshly renovated, with a modern style, comfortable seating, and soft background music that created a peaceful vibe. 🎶🪑🧘

The staff were really friendly, and I even got access to Wi-Fi, which helped me stay productive with some business tasks while enjoying my break. Really appreciated that thoughtful touch. 💻📶😊

While the prices are slightly above average (spent around £20), the portions were generous, the coffee was especially nice, and everything felt well organised. I would definitely recommend this place — a classy little spot with quality all around. 💷☕✅
